submission.justification: Absorber-F3 gives the best simulated resolution at every thickness I tried. The optimum is near 5 mm (3.25%), with 3.28% at 4 mm and 6 mm. F1 and F2 are worse at 2, 5 and 10 mm. WARNING: none of the project documents or tools gives residual dose data, so I could not check the hard 20 uSv/h limit after one week of cooldown. F3 is a dense, short-radiation-length alloy and may activate more than the others. The dose must be checked, for example with an activation calculation, before this choice is final. If F3 fails, the fallback is F1 at about 5 mm (3.9%), and then F2 (5.1%), subject to the same check.

requirements.evidence: F3 at 5 mm gives 3.25%. F3 scans: 2 mm 3.55%, 4 mm 3.28%, 6 mm 3.28%, 10 mm 4.40%. F1 and F2 were worse at 2, 5 and 10 mm.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after 1 week <= 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: No dose or activation data in any document or simulation tool. This was not verified.

requirements.requirement: Material is one of the three candidates
